aboutUs.intro: The 963SY app is an application developed by ArtFly in collaboration with the Syrian Ministry of Tourism. It contributes to the implementation of the Ministry's plan to promote tourism in the country's tourist areas and assets.
aboutUs.description: ArtFly is an institution that has played a significant role in the journey of innovation, photography, documentation, and excellence in the use of drones for aerial photography. The 963SY app provides a comprehensive information package that brings tourism to everyone's fingertips.
aboutUs.quote: "The app provides knowledge about Syria, its history, heritage, and tourist sites, displaying them in special videos and photos that reflect the beauty of #Syria and highlight the exciting experiences that can be enjoyed there."

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro1: ArtFly has designed the 963 App as a free application. This service is provided by ArtFly at no cost and is intended for use as is.
privacy.intro2: This page is used to inform visitors of our policies regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information if anyone decides to use our Service.
privacy.intro3: If you choose to use our Service, you agree to all information related to this policy. We will not use or share your information with any other person or company.
privacy.intro4: Terms used in this Privacy Policy have the same meanings as in our Terms and Conditions, which are accessible on the 963 App unless otherwise defined in this Privacy Policy.

collection.title: Information Collection and Use
collection.text: To provide you with a safe and secure experience while using our Service, we will not ask you to provide us with personally identifiable information or any other type of data, nor will we ask for permission to access your mobile device. The information we request will be retained and used as described in this Privacy Policy.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text1: Cookies are files containing small amounts of data, commonly used as anonymous unique identifiers. They are sent to your browser from websites you visit and stored on your device's internal memory.

providers.title: Service Providers
providers.text1: We may employ third-party companies and individuals for the following reasons:
providers.list2: To provide the Service on our behalf;
providers.list4: To assist us in analyzing how our Service is used.
providers.text2: We want to inform users of this Service that these third parties do not have access to your personal information.

security.title: Security
security.text: The application does not collect any personal information, does not request permission to access mobile data or information, and does not collect any information about your geographic location.

links.title: Links to Other Sites
links.text: This Service may contain links to other sites, including our social media platforms. If you click on a third-party link, you will be directed to that site. Note that these external sites are not operated by us. Therefore, we strongly advise you to review the privacy policies of these sites. We have no control over, and assume no responsibility for, the content, privacy policies, or practices of any third-party websites or services.

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.text: This Service is available to all ages and genders. It does not display any harmful content, and content is actively moderated.

changes.title: Changes to this Privacy Policy
changes.text: We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. Therefore, you are advised to review this page periodically for any changes. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page.
